svg.aria-label: PERP engine system architecture: the browser talks to the axum API over HTTPS and to the ws-gateway over WebSocket; the API writes orders and withdrawals to Postgres in one transaction alongside an outbox row; a relay tails the outbox onto Redis Streams; the matching engine consumes orders from the stream, matches in memory, and both emits engine:events (applied back to Postgres by a ledger-writer) and publishes live updates to Redis Pub/Sub, which the ws-gateway relays to the browser; the worker consumes withdrawal requests from the stream, signs and broadcasts to Solana, and reconciles state back into Postgres; the seeder bootstraps pools and market config once.
svg.text: custodial CEX on Solana — Postgres is the source of truth; Redis relays outbox rows to workers and fans out live updates
claim nonce → sign → persist sig → broadcast
